beforeActivity.question: Do I have to create my company before starting my activity?
beforeActivity.answer: In general, registering your company is a step that comes before running your activity. The exact conditions will be detailed in the official creation guide.

documents.question: Which documents do I need to prepare?
documents.answer: An identity document, an establishment address and information about your activity and legal form are among the required items. The official list will be published with the online registration service.

duration.question: How long does creation take?
duration.answer: The duration depends on your situation and the legal form you choose. It will be specified as soon as the online registration service goes live.

online.question: Can I complete the procedures online?
online.answer: The online registration service will be available soon. In the meantime, this page lets you prepare all the required information.

followUp.question: Can I track my request?
followUp.answer: Once signed in with MyGouv, you will be able to find and track your procedures in your personal space.

help.title: Need help?
